title: GitHub - "Github Services" Feature Webhook Brownout
text:
Service: GitHub
Maintenance: "Github Services" Feature Webhook Brownout
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2019-01-07T19:00:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2019-01-14T19:00:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2019-01-14T19:00:59.137Z: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2019-01-07T19:00:48.377Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2019-01-07T17:59:32.334Z: scheduled - Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
- 2018-12-19T21:27:18.744Z: scheduled - As part of the deprecation process of the "GitHub Services" feature, we have planned a week-long brownout of services webhook deliveries. This brownout will begin on January 7th, at 19:00 UTC, and will end on January 14th, at 19:00 UTC. All other systems are operating normally. More information can be found at https://developer.github.com/changes/2018-11-05-github-services-brownout

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

As part of the deprecation process of the "GitHub Services" feature, we have planned a week-long brownout of services webhook deliveries. This brownout will begin on January 7th, at 19:00 UTC, and will end on January 14th, at 19:00 UTC. All other systems are operating normally. More information can be found at https://developer.github.com/changes/2018-11-05-github-services-brownout
